item.title: One shared place to care for Mom or Dad | Family Care Hub
item.description: One shared place to care for Mom or Dad. The whole family sees the same plan. Family Care Hub: a caregiver planner spreadsheet for Google Sheets and Excel. Medication log with refill dates, appointments, care schedule, tasks, daily log, shared care costs and a fair cost split between family members, plus printable care pages. Instant digital download.
